messages.content: 你被給予一個包含各種變數的資料集，包括「年齡」、「收入」、「教育」、「性別」、「婚姻狀況」和「消費分數」。你想要根據其他變數來預測「消費分數」。請問你能否使用「run_linear_regression」函數建立一個線性迴歸模型，使用「年齡」、「收入」和「教育」作為預測變數，「消費分數」作為目標變數，而不對預測變數進行標準化？然後，你能否再次運行同一個函數，但這次對預測變數進行標準化？

function.name: run_linear_regression
function.description: Build a linear regression model using given predictor variables and a target variable. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

predictors.description: Array containing the names of predictor variables.

standardize.description: Option to apply standardization on the predictors. Defaults to False.

message.reasoning:
The user asks: "Can you use run_linear_regression to build a linear regression model with predictors age, income, education, target consumption score, without standardizing? Then again run same function but this time standardize?" They want us to call the function twice. We need to produce calls to the tool. According to instructions, we should not provide explanation or text outside the function calls. So we need to output two separate calls to functions.run_linear_regression. Each call includes predictors array ["age", "income", "education"], target "consumption_score". For first call, standardize default false. For second call, standardize true.

We need to format as JSON with keys: predictors, target, standardize. For first call, we can omit standardize or set false. Let's include standardize: false. For second call, standardize: true.

We need to output them sequentially. Probably each call in separate line. Use the correct JSON format.
